Question: respected scholar assalamualaikum , in order to get married one must see woman but how much????. 1.only face and hands rest covered by burqa 2.face hands hair ,entire body what is to be covered? 3.if someone has urine dribling problem does she has to tell the person he is marrying?????/ 4.what if anyone comiited zina shall she disclose or not???/ Answer ID: 20899 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 395/395/M=1431) (1 & 2) Seeing the girl before marriage is optional not wajib or necessary. If the boy desires to see the girl whom he is going to marry, in this case he is allowed to see her face etc only once. And the better option is that the boy should send his reliable women relatives and satisfy himself through them. (3) It is better not necessary. (4) For this, sincere and firm tauba and instighfar is necessary, there is no need to disclose it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
